description:
Rename the existing default portfolio from 'My Portfolio' to 'Tech Growth Fund' while preserving all transaction data. 

1. Navigate to the Portfolio Management tab (if not already selected).
2. Right-click on the 'My Portfolio' tab header (or use the Portfolio menu) and select 'Rename...'.
3. Enter the new name 'Tech Growth Fund' and confirm.
4. Verify that the portfolio is now named 'Tech Growth Fund' and still contains the 3 original buy transactions (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA).
